rationale: S-0017-03 proposes implementing AIS compartment, NMDARs, and simulated voltage-clamp block in the downstream DSGC model build task. AIS implementation done in t0052 (synthetic 1 um x 30 um axon initial segment with NEURON hh, AIS_GNABAR_S_PER_CM2 = 1.2). NMDA mechanism done in t0054 (co-located voltage-independent Exp2Syn NMDA at every E synapse) and being extended to Mg-block in t0055. Voltage-clamp block (somatic SEClamp re-measurement of conductances) done in t0049 (seclamp_cond_remeasure). All three pieces of the 7-point patch-clamp specification covered. Rejecting as covered.
